message.content: The largest planet that has been confirmed so far is **HD 100546 b**, a gas giant orbiting the young star HD 100546. It has a radius of about 2.5 × the radius of Jupiter (≈ 2.5 R_J) and a mass roughly 10–20 times that of Jupiter. This makes it the biggest planet we know of in the entire observable universe.
